name: A11Y.md Benchmark
description: Complete dataset of the A11Y.md efficacy benchmark. Study 1 (pre-registered at osf.io/pg6r5): 400 API generations across 4 conditions (bare / generic request / size-matched placebo standard / A11Y.md with lazy loading) plus 54 ecological runs across three real coding agents — every generated page, axe-core 4.13.0 report, full-page screenshot, collection log with per-call model versions, blind-adjudication worksheets and loading-behaviour classification. Study 2 (pre-registered at osf.io/mqs7x): 30 seven-screen journeys in single real-agent sessions — screens, verification reports, screenshots, frozen consistency-classifier output and the registered analysis. SHA-256 manifests cover every file. Deviations from the registered protocols are documented, dated, in the repository's DEVIATIONS files.
